title: Three hadasim: dancing before the kallah
summary: Rav Shmuel bar Rav Yitzchak juggled three hadasim before the kallah: why hadasim, why three, and why Chazal saw something in it that only one or two in a generation see. When to stop learning for a levaya or a chuppah, why a king may not forgo his honor, and the bracha on seeing a king. Then Rabbi Pinchas ben Yair's donkey that would not eat untithed grain, and the kezazah, Chazal's way of marking a marriage that should not have been.
